---
title: Quarto extensions
author: Mickaël Canouil
format: mcanouil-revealjs
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    speakers:
      - photo: speaker.svg
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A speaker photo without alt text warns once, and the photo keeps an empty alt.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'mcanouil: the speaker photo "speaker\.svg" has no alt text'
        count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['class="mc-speaker-photo" src="data:image/svg\+xml;base64,[^"]+" alt=""']
---
